sections.title: Batch 8 — Module 6: describe a job (Batch 8B, the screens; 24 Nov 2026)
points: Describe a job (customers; the card on Find workers and the menu): type or speak (🎤) the job in your own words, press Check my words, and the words the app used are marked. Step 2 shows every suggested detail as a picture choice with the words that led to it; you change anything. Step 3 saves the job request (JR-…).

Checking again never overwrites what you changed: a changed detail keeps your choice and the new suggestion is only offered ("New suggestion: X — use it?"); a tie or no trade words chooses nothing (D-093).

My job requests: tabs by state with counts; the job request page: the details, only the allowed buttons (change, choose a worker, close with a reason, delete), the requests sent, and "What the app understood from your words" (kept / changed / nothing suggested; never a score).

Workers for this job: workers of the trade in your city, in the order you choose (not a ranking), each with its reasons; Send this job opens the request page with a read-only "Your job" card; one request at a time, refused in plain words (D-096).
Workers see "From job request JR-…" and the kind of work on the request (also spoken by 🔊), never the budget; the budget is shown only on the customer's own job pages and to admins (D-100).
Admins: Job requests (list without budget, the detail drawer), "How suggestions were used" (use, not correctness) and "Try the analyzer" (D-098).
Easy mode on every new page: 🔊 help on every field and picture, 🎤 where allowed, page help, three languages, right to left, both themes; the Help Centre guide "Describe a job".

Word lists 2026-11-24-v3 (before any real description; no rule of the protocol changed, "Protocol changes" 3): a city spelling that is also an everyday word (atak, اٹک, wah, mari, مری) names the city only directly before a place word ("مری میں" = in Murree); a city spelling directly before road, rd, روڈ, chowk or چوک is a road, not the city ("Murree Road Rawalpindi" → Rawalpindi); new phrases لیک, پائپ لیک, pipe leak, گٹر بند, سیم, دروازہ اٹک, darwaza atak, istari, بزرگوں کی دیکھ بھال, ماسی چاہیے, maasi chahiye, masi chahiye; task words فٹ کرنا, فٹنگ (install) and ghar ke kaam, گھر کے کام (household help, D-097). Module 2's output is unchanged.

sections.title: Batch 8A — Module 6, Problem/Job Analyzer: backend, analyzers, evaluation harness (23–24 Nov 2026)
points: Job requests (/api/job-requests): analyze a text (nothing saved), save the confirmed job (JR-2026-000001), list, read, edit with versions (only while open), close, delete (never after a booking); derived states open, requested, accepted, done, expired (30 days), closed; limits 10 open and 10 new per day.

Workers for this job: a filter (same trade, same city — "Pindi" = "Rawalpindi" —, listed, not suspended) in the customer's directory sort, with the reasons; never a phone number, WhatsApp, CNIC, email or address.

The request with the job: the same checks as a normal request (one shared code path) plus "a skill of the job's trade"; one open request per job by a reservation (two taps: one 201, one 409); the booking copies the job's city, area and description; the worker sees the job code and the kind of work, never the budget.

The rule-based analyzer job-rules-1: Module 2's normalisation plus Roman Urdu spelling variants, 188 problem phrases (44 in Urdu script), task-type words, city, day, time, urgency, budget and an address hint, with the words that led to each suggestion and no score. npm run jobs:try -- "<text>". Module 2's output is unchanged.

The team's naive Bayes classifier (plain JavaScript) and the hybrid: hand-worked numbers as unit tests; the production server refuses a model trained on synthetic data; live method: rules until Batch 8C.

Evaluation harness (backend/evaluation/job-analysis/): split, cross-validation, the compared systems, McNemar exact and mid-p, Holm, bootstrap intervals, agreement; tested on SYNTHETIC data only (no number from it is a result). The protocol is pre-registered and frozen at 81ba8f6 (docs/evaluation/job-analysis/PROTOCOL.md).
Documents for real data: consent text (three languages, drafts), form draft, collection plan, annotation guide, data-handling note. Questions for the supervisor in docs/modules/MODULE-6.md §11.
Admins: a read-only job list (no budget), the detail (budget, analysis, bookings, the customer's name only) and use statistics "kept / changed / not suggested" (use, not accuracy).

sections.title: Batch 7 — Module 5, fair wage and work protection (19–23 Nov 2026)
points: Price information: under the chosen skill on "Request this worker" and on a new Price information page: the typical price on this platform (the middle half of agreed prices, only from at least 5 jobs by 3 workers for 3 customers, one job per pair, both-confirmed, last 12 months), else the admin team's price guide with its source and month, the government minimum wage reference for the region (with its status, date and sources), and the worker's own rates. 🔊 reads it all, amounts in words.

Agreed price and conditions on the booking: an optional offer with the request; then either person proposes, the other agrees, with picture cards (whole job / per day / per hour, a −/+ stepper, how long), the important conditions of the trade (materials, advance, payment time and method, visit charge), the fixed rule "Extra work only after a new price is agreed in the app", and a read-back with 🔊 before Send or Agree. Every version is kept.

Rule-based checks that warn and never block: below the minimum wage reference for a day, an hour or a job of one or 2–3 days; a large advance; materials bought by the worker without an advance; missing conditions; below most prices on this platform. Shown to both people.

Payment records: "I paid" / "I received", confirmed only by the other person ("Yes, I received it"), or "This is not right" with a reason; never edited, never confirmed automatically. A summary line, a printable record ("not a bank receipt"), and My earnings for workers (only confirmed money in the total).

Work protection: short tips for workers and customers on the request, the Requests card, the booking and the payment card; a Help Centre guide "Fair pay and safe work" with the minimum wage table and helplines with sources.

Admins: Price guide (only with a written source; edit, archive, history), Payments (read-only, disputed first; Module 9 will decide), a payments CSV, an Overview banner when a wage figure is more than a year old.

SIMULATION (30 seeds per scenario; docs/modules/MODULE-5.md §8; not real prices): the rules make the range appear in fewer markets (availability 0.348 against 0.887 for a plain average in base), with a slightly smaller error (0.097 against 0.108) and a much smaller shift from one dishonest worker (0.086 against 0.600 in inflator) or pair (0.039 against 0.469 in pair_flood). Attacks can still make a range appear in a market with too few jobs.
Part A, docs only (D-079): the deploy runbook's health check corrected: /api/health proves the function starts; /api/auth/session (200 / 503) is the database check.
